description: Na₆Sn₂S₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.22 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.38 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.76 Å) and two longer (2.80 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.03 Å. Sn is bonded to four S atoms to form SnS₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SnS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 23°. There are a spread of Sn-S bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.44 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted SNa₄Sn square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₅Sn octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Sn square pyramids, and edges with three equivalent SNa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 92°. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form SNa₅Sn octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₅Sn octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SNa₄Sn square pyramid, edges with two equivalent SNa₅Sn octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₄Sn square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sn atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Sn atoms.
